question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **tongue**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tongue **refers to the muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and speaking. (जीभ)

 
 
• **Example**: *The doctor asked the patient to stick out their tongue to examine its condition and check for any abnormalities.*
 
 
 
• *​*A slip of the tongue, as described in the sentence, has the potential to create an enemy where the speaker had hoped to win a friend.
 
• This suggests that careless speech, represented by a slip of the tongue, can harm relationships or create misunderstandings.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ear**: The organ of hearing and balance in humans and other vertebrates. (कान)
 
• **Word**: A unit of language, consisting of one or more spoken sounds or their written representation. (शब्द)
 
• **Pen**: A writing instrument that uses ink to leave a mark on a surface, typically paper. (कलम)
